tailoring.headline: Techno-Functional E-Commerce Project Manager & SAP Commerce Cloud Developer
tailoring.summary: Techno-functional e-commerce project manager and backend developer with 5+ years of experience delivering enterprise SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, RESTful APIs, and PIM/ERP/MDM data integrations. Proven strength in requirements analysis, process mapping, stakeholder management, and agile delivery. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer ready to drive technical project execution.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Technischer Projektmanager E-Commerce (m/w/d)
cover_en.hook: intedia GmbH's reputation for delivering sophisticated e-commerce solutions makes this Technischer Projektmanager role an exciting next step for my career. With over 5 years of hands-on technical and functional experience building enterprise SAP Commerce Cloud platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bridge the gap between business requirements and technical execution.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Leadership
bullets.text: Worked closely with business stakeholders and international teams to analyse requirements, write user stories and functional specifications, and translate them into robust SAP Commerce solutions.

bullets.label: E-Commerce Integration
bullets.text: Designed, built, and optimized complex PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines using Profisee, Hotfolders, and DataHub while resolving integration bottlenecks between SAP ERP, MDM, and e-commerce channels.

bullets.label: API & Platform Delivery
bullets.text: Developed OCC REST Web Services and executed CI/CD deployment cycles on SAP Commerce Cloud (CCv2) within fast-paced agile DevOps workflows.

bullets.label: Process Optimization
bullets.text: Engineered API migrations for customer account structures, led database query refactoring to reduce latency, and supported user acceptance testing (UAT) alongside product owners.

cover_en.logistics: I am based in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit, and am serving my notice period with a last working day of 15 December 2026 (earliest start: 16 December 2026). I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my techno-functional expertise can support intedia GmbH.

tailoring.why_company: intedia GmbH combines strategic e-commerce vision with technical excellence, creating an ideal environment for my techno-functional background. Having successfully delivered complex enterprise platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am eager to apply my expertise in requirements engineering, stakeholder management, and SAP Commerce integration to drive high-impact projects for intedia's clients.
tailoring.motivation_short: Driving e-commerce project success by bridging business strategy and technical execution in SAP Commerce environments.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello! With 5+ years building enterprise SAP Commerce platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring strong techno-functional expertise in stakeholder management, requirements analysis, and integrations. Let's connect regarding intedia's E-Commerce Project Manager role!
tailoring.email_subject: Application: Technischer Projektmanager E-Commerce (m/w/d) – Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my application documents for the Technischer Projektmanager E-Commerce position at intedia GmbH.

With over 5 years of professional experience delivering enterprise SAP Commerce platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep techno-functional expertise spanning requirements analysis, complex integrations, and agile project delivery. My CV and cover letter are attached for your review.

I look forward to discussing how I can contribute to your team.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
